newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-NO LIVERPOOL OFFER FOR RIEDLE - DORTMUND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NO LIVERPOOL OFFER FOR RIEDLE - DORTMUND.

text.p: European champions Borussia Dortmund said on Thursday that they had received no offer from Liverpool for international striker Karlheinz Riedle.

"We have not received any offer from Liverpool," said Dortmund spokesman Josef Schneck. "It's just another story. We've heard many lately about Riedle or other players such as (midfielder Joerg) Heinrich," he added.
According to press reports, Liverpool offered Riedle a three-year contract for a 4.5 million marks ($2.5 million) transfer fee.
Riedle has also been linked to Italian second division side Perugia, former club of Dortmund's new coach Nevio Scala.
